title: list-rows does not take a menu that lists a kept person's page for the team list
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm the test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A team list cut to one person whose name is also a menu item title: the footer menu of four items (one of them the name) is not judged as the team list; the row is unread, with no failure.
A team list that really prints four people with the kept person's role words still fails with 4 printed.

tests: a kept row whose name is also a menu title is not found in the menu: the footer menu is not the team list
